title: Cohomology of the pure symmetric automorphisms of right-angled Artin groups
summary: We compute the cohomology groups of the pure symmetric outer automorphism group $Σ$POut$(A_Γ)$ and the pure symmetric automorphism group $Σ$PAut$(A_Γ)$ of a right-angled Artin group $A_Γ$. Using the equivariant spectral sequence arising from the action of $Σ$POut$(A_Γ)$ on the generalized McCullough-Miller complex MM$_Γ$, we show that $H^q(Σ$POut$(A_Γ))$ is free abelian and we compute its rank in terms of the combinatorics of certain poset.
